title: Prep Drill Log Completion Percent Leaderboard
dataSources: Go-bag inventories (`gobag:inventory`), prep drills (`prep:drill`), water rotation logs (`water:rotation`), battery expiration checks (`battery:expiration`), and radio tests (`radio:test`).
app: Go-bag inventory audits, household prep drill logs, water rotation schedules, battery expiration trackers, and emergency radio test results streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prep:drill completion_pct=*
| stats sum(completion_pct) as total_value, avg(completion_pct) as avg_value by drill_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks drill type values by total and average completion percent across prep drill log events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `completion_pct` values for each prep drill log event and review total and average completion percent by drill type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total completion percent.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which drill type shows the biggest completion percent numbers in your prep drill log data.
